findings.title: Mixed HR/RR result still displayed and encoded as HR

evidence.quote: 1.11% per year in the group that received 150 mg of dabigatran (relative risk, 0.66; 95% CI, 0.53 to 0.82; P<0.001 for superiority)

findings.why_wrong: The selected RE-LY estimate is explicitly a relative risk. Its study_effect object relabels it HR, and the mixed pooled number is also displayed as HR. The adjacent mixed-measure disclosure acknowledges the composition but does not make either HR label correct.
findings.served_effect: Readers and consumers of review.json can interpret the mixed estimate as a hazard ratio; RE-LY's structured estimand contradicts its source and its own RR scale.
findings.proposed_fixture: Use the held RE-LY 150 mg clause and the three held HR efficacy rows. Assert that RE-LY study_effect.estimand remains RR and that a mixed result is not encoded or rendered as an unqualified HR. The current JSON and HTML fail these assertions.

findings.title: RE-LY major-bleeding rates classified as absent despite being held

evidence.quote: The rate of major bleeding was 3.36% per year in the warfarin group, as compared with 2.71% per year in the group receiving 110 mg of dabigatran (P=0.003) and 3.11% per year in the group receiving 150 mg of dabigatran (P=0.31).

findings.why_wrong: The abstract contains dose-specific major-bleeding rates, including the selected 150 mg regimen. Absence of a source-supported RR-plus-CI tuple does not mean the outcome is absent. An offline call to unextracted.audit_pair with the held abstract reproduces NOT_IN_HELD_SOURCES.
findings.served_effect: The coverage audit hides a held but unextracted quantitative outcome. This finding does not establish that the rejected hand-entered RR and CI are source-supported or should be pooled.
findings.proposed_fixture: Supply the quoted bleeding sentence as an abstract source to unextracted.audit_pair for trial 19717844, outcome Major bleeding, keywords ['major bleeding'], and no extracted trials. Assert HELD_NOT_EXTRACTED while leaving any unsupported RR/CI unpooled. Current code returns NOT_IN_HELD_SOURCES.

findings.title: ARISTOTLE bleeding result inherits the stroke endpoint definition

claim.quote: "trial_family_id": "NCT00412984", "publication_role": "primary", "analysis_set": null, "follow_up_window": null, "endpoint_definition": "primary outcome was ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke or systemic embolism"

evidence.quote: The rate of major bleeding was 2.13% per year in the apixaban group, as compared with 3.09% per year in the warfarin group (hazard ratio, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.60 to 0.80; P<0.001)
The primary outcome was ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke or systemic embolism.

findings.why_wrong: The affected row is the Major bleeding HR 0.69 result. Its endpoint_definition instead describes the separate primary efficacy outcome. compat_check._derive_endpoint searches the whole record for a primary-outcome definition and reproduces this incorrect attachment.
findings.served_effect: The bleeding row displays a stroke/systemic-embolism definition and contributes to a false endpoint-heterogeneity flag. The bleeding estimate itself matches the held bleeding clause.
findings.proposed_fixture: Pass the held ARISTOTLE abstract and its HR 0.69 bleeding row to compat_check._derive_endpoint with outcome.name='Major bleeding'. Assert that the derived definition describes major bleeding and does not contain the primary stroke/systemic-embolism definition. Current code returns the latter.

findings.title: ROCKET-AF ITT result receives per-protocol analysis metadata

evidence.quote: In the intention-to-treat analysis, the primary end point occurred in 269 patients in the rivaroxaban group (2.1% per year) and in 306 patients in the warfarin group (2.4% per year) (hazard ratio, 0.88; 95% CI, 0.74 to 1.03; P<0.001 for noninferiority; P=0.12 for superiority).

findings.why_wrong: The selected effect is HR 0.88, explicitly identified as intention-to-treat in the held result clause. The metadata extractor prioritizes a per-protocol mention elsewhere in the abstract and assigns that analysis set to the ITT result.
findings.served_effect: The page labels the selected ROCKET-AF row per-protocol and describes the efficacy pool as mixed ITT/per-protocol, despite selecting the ITT estimate.
findings.proposed_fixture: Use the complete held ROCKET-AF abstract and selected HR 0.88 row, including its endpoint_result_span, as input to compat_check._derive_analysis_set. Assert intention-to-treat. Current code returns per-protocol; the result-bound fix must preserve the selected clause's analysis identity.
